svg.title: The Purdue model: distance from the thing that moves
svg.desc: Levels from the bottom: Level 0 field devices such as sensors, actuators, motors, and valves; Level 1 control with PLCs, RTUs, and safety systems; Level 2 supervisory with SCADA servers, DCS, and HMIs; Level 3 manufacturing operations with historians, MES, and engineering workstations; Level 3.5 the industrial DMZ with data diodes, jump servers, and protocol converters; and Level 4 business logistics with ERP, email, and the internet. A failure at the bottom can injure somebody; at the top it is expensive. Cellular modems and vendor remote access can bypass every level.
svg.text: The Purdue model: distance from the thing that moves

g.text: data diodes, jump servers, protocol converters
